stem: Ferro Systems has two VPCs that need direct connectivity today, but its roadmap already lists eleven more VPCs and three VPN sites joining over the next year, and leadership wants to avoid re-architecting the hub each time one joins.

choices.text: Create a VPC peering connection between the two VPCs today
Build the connectivity on a Transit Gateway hub
Add a new VPC peering connection each time a VPC joins
Attach each new VPC directly to the existing hybrid gateway without a transit hub

rationale: A Transit Gateway hub lets new VPCs and VPN sites attach without re-architecting existing connectivity. Peering meets today's two-VPC need but does not scale without adding a new connection for every future VPC. Attaching each new VPC to an existing hybrid gateway does not give VPCs a way to route to each other, so it is not a substitute for a VPC-to-VPC transit hub.
